reasons: CS3231 is offered only in Sem 1, so it must be placed in Sem 7 or 8. Sem 8 is reserved for the mandatory CS3227.
CS3237 requires ST2334. ST2334 is placed in Sem 6 to allow CS3237 in Sem 7.
CS2102 is placed in Sem 6 to satisfy the 2-module limit and keep it apart from ST2334 if possible, but ST2334 is needed early for CS3237. CS3231 and CS3237 are grouped in Sem 7 as preferred.
